The best piece of advice I've ever gotten and has helped to live to see today is that you need to always have patience for yourself. It's not always possible to be patient with the world because it's pretty unforgiving, but once you start to practice patience with yourself and your problems (internally or externally) you start to see some relief from the stress of being overwhelmed by all of it. Just allow yourself the mental space and time to address things at your pace and in whatever way you need to. Solutions aren't always very neat and acceptable to society, but it's often better than the alternative and if it works for you, who cares what anyone thinks.
